description: Texas Synthetic Power System Test Case (TX-123BT).zip is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Jin Lu, Xingpeng Li. The dataset of the synthetic Texas 123-bus backbone transmission (TX-123BT) system.The procedures and details to create TX-123BT system are described in the paper below:Jin Lu, Xingpeng Li et al., “A Synthetic Texas Backbone Power System with Climate-Dependent Spatio-Temporal Correlated Profiles”.If you use this dataset in your work, please cite the paper above. Coverage: Texas. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 544473438 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
